prior_status: The exact indicator tensor ledger was proved and coefficient two was refuted by an all-depth seed requiring K>=3.921809106893846..., but coefficient four remained a possible unsigned payment for the agreement/disagreement activation split.
mathematical_delta: Derived the exact r-bit co-singleton family and proved Phi/I>4 for every r>=3 with tensor-depth invariance; certified a six-bit seed with Phi/I=4.512256384896659...>4.5 and propagated it to every tensor depth; bounded the corresponding genuine-Boolean FEI ratios.

case_extension.new_bound: coefficient four is false; every universal Phi(q)<=K I(q) requires K>=4.512256384896659... and in particular K>4.5

verification.method: integer Walsh transforms, exact rational Parseval and influence, exact integer log-sign comparisons, closed-form co-singleton proof, deterministic simulated annealing, direct tensor checks

obstruction_controls: The result concerns the normalized indicator remainder and is not confused with RAW_CONV_TENSOR.
Tensor powers show that the coefficient failure is multiplicative and is not an additive support term erased by depth.
The sign companions are genuine Boolean functions with bounded H/I, so no FEI counterexample is claimed.
The tensor identity is disjoint-product exact and is not misreported as overlapping-input closure; OVERLAP_PRODUCT remains live.
The failure blocks only an independently unsigned activation projection; it does not refute a joint signed, posterior, or terminal-reserve payment.
Numerical candidates above the certified six-bit value are preserved as leads and are not promoted to exact claims.
remaining_obstacle: Pay the changing coherent remainder over an actual adaptive physical hierarchy with one source-influence or terminal-reserve budget. The coefficient-four independent indicator projection is impossible; the signed near/separated kernel must retain companion-sign, posterior-activation, or terminal-reserve information under changing node weights.
next_action: Return to the exact split |a_T+mu b_T|<=c|alpha b_T| versus its complement and derive a joint four-channel signed inequality rather than separate indicator estimates. Stress-test any unsigned subterm on the six-bit tensor family and require coefficient at least 4.512256384896659....
